item.title: Mandatory Service Charge Declared Illegal: CCPA Penalizes Restaurants Across India
item.description: CCPA has enforced consumer protection law against 27 restaurants; automatic service charge deemed illegal, penalties imposed to curb unfair trade practices. The post Mandatory Service Charge Declared Illegal: CCPA Penalizes Restaurants Across India appeared first on SCC Times.

item.title: Delhi High Court takes Suo Motu Cognizance as Patients & Kin Brave Cold Outside Hospitals, Night Shelters Overflow
item.description: The Court said that “to our mind, this issue calls for urgent executive and/or judicial intervention.” The post Delhi High Court takes Suo Motu Cognizance as Patients & Kin Brave Cold Outside Hospitals, Night Shelters Overflow appeared first on SCC Times.

item.title: In the Hot Seat: Dr. Abhishek Manu Singhvi
item.description: Our debut features Dr. Abhishek Manu Singhvi in an engaging, reflective exchange with Simran Kohli (JSA), blending legal insight with a light-hearted fun round. Because the law is shaped not just by arguments but by the people behind them. The post In the Hot Seat: Dr. Abhishek Manu Singhvi appeared first on SCC Times.

item.title: Kerala HC strikes down S. 9 of Kerala Devaswom Recruitment Board Act; upholds Guruvayoor Devaswom’s statutory autonomy over appointments
item.description: “It is settled that a special law prevails over a general law, and a non obstante clause in a later enactment cannot obliterate the legislative intent of a prior special statute, particularly one governing a unique and constitutionally protected religious institution like the Guruvayoor Devaswom.” The post Kerala HC strikes down S. 9 of Kerala Devaswom Recruitment Board Act; upholds Guruvayoor Devaswom’s statutory autonomy over appointments appeared first on SCC Times.

item.title: Tenant can’t dispute admitted tenant-landlord relationship by plea of oral sale; Delhi HC upholds eviction on Bona fide requirement
item.description: Landlord’s bona fide requirement for himself or for his dependent family members, founded on age, medical condition and need for financial independence of his children, constitutes a genuine and valid ground for eviction. The post Tenant can’t dispute admitted tenant-landlord relationship by plea of oral sale; Delhi HC upholds eviction on Bona fide requirement appeared first on SCC Times.

item.title: Chhattisgarh HC denies anticipatory bail to two men for staging demonstration, manhandling police inside Courtroom in Ashutosh Chaitanya Case
item.description: “The discretionary relief of anticipatory bail is not meant to shield persons who, prima facie, appear to have participated in acts undermining public order and the sanctity of judicial institutions.” The post Chhattisgarh HC denies anticipatory bail to two men for staging demonstration, manhandling police inside Courtroom in Ashutosh Chaitanya Case appeared first on SCC Times.

item.title: Orissa High Court: Deceased tenant’s name cannot be removed from Record of Rights through Writ; Mutation proceedings essential
item.description: “The Court cannot pass a blanket order in a writ petition directing deletion of the name of a dead person, because some formalities as per law are required to be made before the Tahasildar through a Mutation Proceeding.” The post Orissa High Court: Deceased tenant’s name cannot be removed from Record of Rights through Writ; Mutation proceedings essential appeared first on SCC Times.
